name: Spain (national picks)
tagline: Five gems off the usual circuit: Girona, a Basque farmhouse, an 1898 Asturian inn, the Galician estuary, and Seville.

El Celler de Can Roca.description: The Roca brothers' temple in Girona, named the world's best restaurant in 2013 and 2015. Three Michelin stars.

Asador Etxebarri.description: Bittor Arginzoniz's grill in a Bizkaia farmhouse, #2 in the world on The World's 50 Best 2024. One Michelin star.

Casa Marcial.description: Nacho Manzano's Asturian landscape cuisine, in a former family inn from 1898. Three Michelin stars, three Repsol Suns.

Casa Solla.description: Galician-rooted cuisine built on estuary produce, from chef Pepe Solla, heir to the family tradition. One Michelin star.

Abantal.description: Contemporary Andalusian cuisine from chef Julio Fernández, a fine-dining reference in Seville. One Michelin star.
